subject: Scheduling: Cross-region product demo — Acme Corp (US/EU/APAC)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Laurent <sophie.laurent@acme-eu.com>, Kenji Tanaka <kenji.t@acme-apac.com>, Michael Reed <michael.reed@acme.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-28T16:10:00-04:00
Subject: Scheduling: Cross-region product demo — Acme Corp (US/EU/APAC)

Hi Sophie / Kenji / Michael —

Thanks again for your time last week. We'd love to schedule a 60-minute product demo with the cross-functional Acme team (sales + platform + engineering). Because participants are spread across US / EU / APAC, I wanted to propose a few time windows that try to balance exec availability and regional convenience. All times below are presented with local equivalents (EDT / CEST / JST) for clarity.

Proposal windows (60 min):
- Option A — Thu, Jul 8 08:00 EDT / 14:00 CEST / 21:00 JST
- Option B — Wed, Jul 7 21:00 EDT / Thu, Jul 8 03:00 CEST / Thu, Jul 8 10:00 JST
- Option C — Fri, Jul 9 09:00 EDT / 15:00 CEST / 22:00 JST

Notes on DST: July in the US/EU/Japan has established DST offsets (EDT = UTC-4, CEST = UTC+2, JST = UTC+9). I included the local equivalents so everyone can check against local calendars.

Agenda (high level):
1) 10 min intros + goals
2) 30 min platform demo (serving runtime, routing, cost controls)
3) 15 min integration/next steps + Q&A
4) 5 min mutual action plan review

I've attached a one-page mutual_action_plan.xlsx and a timezone_availability.ics that shows the proposed slots in calendar form. Please reply with your preferred option or specific availability constraints. If you can, indicate whether your execs prefer mornings/evenings in their local time (we can shift accordingly).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx, timezone_availability.ics

From: Sophie Laurent <sophie.laurent@acme-eu.com>

Subject: Re: Scheduling: Cross-region product demo — Acme Corp (US/EU/APAC)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks — these options help. A couple of notes from the EU side: our product & platform leads prefer afternoons CEST where possible. Friday Jul 9 is tight for our exec team (QBR prep).

Of the options you listed, Option A (Jul 8 14:00 CEST) works best for most people in EU — that corresponds to 08:00 EDT and 21:00 JST. Morning EU times (e.g., 09:00 CEST) are difficult for several senior folks.

If possible, could we aim for Jul 8 14:00 CEST? If Kenji's team prefers earlier JST morning, maybe we can fold them into Option B, but Option B (03:00 CEST) is tough for EU.

I've attached a short PDF with exec availability for our side (acme_exec_availability.pdf) and a Calendly link for optional slots: https://calendly.com/acme/exec-demo-availability

Best,
Sophie
Head of Platform Partnerships | Acme Corp
sophie.laurent@acme-eu.com

Attachment: acme_exec_availability.pdf

From: Kenji Tanaka <kenji.t@acme-apac.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sophie Laurent <sophie.laurent@acme-eu.com>
Cc: Michael Reed <michael.reed@acme.com>
Date: 2026-06-29T17:20:00+09:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling: Cross-region product demo — Acme Corp (US/EU/APAC)

Hi all —

Thanks for proposing options. APAC preference is for local morning times (08:00—11:00 JST) where possible; late evenings past 22:30 JST are difficult for our execs due to childcare schedules.

Option A (21:00 JST on Jul 8) is pretty late but could be doable for a couple of folks. Option B would actually line up well with our morning (10:00 JST) if the meeting were scheduled for Jul 8 10:00 JST — that maps to Jul 7 21:00 EDT / Jul 8 03:00 CEST which Sophie flagged as tough for EU.

If EU prefers Jul 8 14:00 CEST, that is 21:00 JST. I can check with my VP — would your team have an exec able to join at 21:00 JST / 08:00 EDT? If yes, that seems like the least disruptive cross-region compromise.

— Kenji
Director, Platform & Ops | Acme APAC
kenji.t@acme-apac.com

Thanks — quick yes/no works.
